sloka: सहाय कृत्यम् किम् तस्य येन सप्त महाद्रुमाः ।शैलः च वसुधा चैव बाणेन एकेन दारिताः ॥४-३६-८॥
transliteration: sahāya kṛtyam kim tasya yena sapta mahādrumāḥ ।śailaḥ ca vasudhā caiva bāṇena ekena dāritāḥ ॥4-36-8॥

translations.english: 'Rama shattered seven huge trees, a mountain and earth with a single arrow. What assistance does he need?
